title: ComfyUI - ADE20K Workflow for Terrain Texture Generation
author: EDWARDPIPER93
selftext:
A little workflow I've been experimenting with. Using ComfyUI and the ADE20K semantic colour codes controlnet you can use texture painting in blender to segment areas for retexturing in comfy ui. sometimes requiring a few generations to get a solid result but works fairly well! 

Workflow: [https://pastebin.com/Ad6wjZ6g](https://pastebin.com/Ad6wjZ6g)

ADE20k semantic colour codes: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1se8YEtb2detS7OuPE86fXGyD269pMycAWe2mtKUj2W8/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1se8YEtb2detS7OuPE86fXGyD269pMycAWe2mtKUj2W8/edit?usp=sharing)

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
Wonderful! I did some similar tests a year or so back. This terrain art was a huge part of the mod scene for RTS and RTT games like Myth back in the day.

I'm surprised you're using SD1.5. Why not use a more modern model? I'm pretty sure you could get some stellar results with qwen-image and some custom loras on a small training set.

replies.author: EDWARDPIPER93
replies.body: Thank you! I was going for iteration speed for this round of testing so being able to pop an image out in under a second was really helpful! There will be more post-processing to retro-ify the image textures, so for now, this is working for me!

comments.author: El_Chuuupacabra
comments.body: Great job! That's one of the very few useful things posted here.

comments.author: SylvanCreatures
comments.body: Very similar to procedural approaches, so slots in well with existing flows- nice work!!

comments.author: Objective_Ad_3937
comments.body:
So then you export it to blender, and set the hights using the first file? Do you have a Blender file for example?

Thanks

replies.author: EDWARDPIPER93
replies.body:
Yes I created a plane in blender, sculpted it using the sculpting tools, and then used texture painting to paint in the areas where the different colour segments needed to go. Then I exported that painted texture as a png into ComfyUI and did the workflow. That final image texture was brought back into blender for the final model. 

Example here: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/10WenlJjT4jZ3NBpu2QccF\_bfh6DTOTcX/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10WenlJjT4jZ3NBpu2QccF_bfh6DTOTcX/view?usp=sharing)
